sections.heading: Where to Launch
sections.body: The affinity index identifies **Tokyo** as the top city with a lift of 1.86 and high confidence [q21, q22]. Other primary locations include **San Francisco** with a lift of 1.28 and high confidence [q7, q8], and **Los Angeles** with a lift of 1.23 and high confidence [q5, q6].

sections.heading: Who the Players Are
sections.body: The audience for **Moss Hollow** skews female by +46.9% and male by -46.9% [q27]. The age skew is +7.5% for those 25-29, while those 24 and under are -9.6% [q27].

sections.heading: Who to Partner With
sections.body: Potential partners include artists such as **Waterparks** and **Cavetown** [q28]. The studio could also engage with brands like **Twitch** and **Playstation** [q31] or podcasts such as **Welcome to Night Vale** [q29].

sections.heading: How to Split the Budget
sections.body: From a total budget of $3,000.00, allocate 14.76% ($442.89) to **Tokyo** [q21, q22]. Assign 10.16% ($304.92) to **San Francisco** [q7, q8] and 9.70% ($291.15) to **Los Angeles** [q5, q6].

sections.heading: Caveats
sections.body: Certain regions show lower affinity, such as **Warsaw** with a lift of 0.87 [q19, q20]. Audience skews are significantly negative for those 55+ at -23.4% and those 30-34 at -23.1% [q27].

limits: Affinity index, not a sales forecast.
Qloo measures taste affinity from consumption data, not sales or wishlists.
New indie games are usually not in Qloo yet, so the plan works through comparable games.
City-level results cannot be validated with free public data.
Brands are global: Qloo brand affinity ignores location.
In our language-level backtest (6 shipped games vs Steam review languages), this ranking beat a popularity baseline in only 1 of 6 games. Treat it as a taste-informed starting hypothesis.
